# A fallback password after ?: is still a hard-coded secret.
# ruleid: build-gradle-password-hardcoded
password = env["ARTIFACTORY_PASSWORD"] ?: "s3cr3t-deploy-value"
# ruleid: build-gradle-password-hardcoded
password = env["MAVEN_PASSWORD"] ?: "an0ther-hardcoded-value"
# ok: build-gradle-password-hardcoded
username = env["ARTIFACTORY_USER"] ?: "deployer"
# ok: build-gradle-password-hardcoded
password = credentialsFromVault("artifactory")
